title: OCPNODE-2018: Add OCI Referrers API support for signature discovery
body:
Fixes #221

Add support for discovering sigstore signatures via the OCI Distribution Spec 1.1 Referrers API (`GET /v2/<name>/referrers/<digest>`), with automatic fallback to the referrers tag schema for registries that don't support the API. Reuses the existing `use-sigstore-attachments` configuration flag.

This covers the read/discovery path only. Write-side support is follow-up work.
